stem: The LTV of Business Care, Voltmarkt's device-support subscription for small offices, is €1,200 under Voltmarkt's convention. What does this figure mean?

options.text: An average business pays €1,200 of subscription fees before it cancels
An average business stays subscribed for 1,200 days before it cancels
Business Care earns €1,200 of gross profit from all businesses each month
An average business brings about €1,200 of gross profit over its life
